name: How long does a typical leak detection appointment take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical leak detection appointment take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a leak detection appointment can vary, typically ranging from one to several hours, depending on the leak's complexity and location. Simple, accessible leaks are quicker to find, while hidden leaks behind walls, under concrete slabs, or in irrigation systems may require more extensive investigation with specialized equipment. We prioritize thoroughness to accurately pinpoint the issue.
acceptedAnswer.description: Leak detection appointments typically last one to several hours, depending on the complexity and location of the leak.
